snippet.title: Cat-A-Strophic Trailer
snippet.description:
Cat-A-Strophic is a stylised 3D sandbox destruction game, where you play as a giant kaiju cat, rampaging across the city to cause maximum destruction to save her baby kittens!

Check out our early demo build on itch.io and follow our socials for the latest updates!
Itch.io: https://purrpointproductions.itch.io/cat-a-strophic
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/purrpointproduction/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@purrpointproduction
